summary: Saturn aspecting the lagna gives burdens, delays, a serious and austere temperament and early misfortune in the classical and Raman's reading; Braha links it with a spiritual, renunciate bent.
common_outcomes: troubled by heavy loads, travel and illness; irritable; lacking happiness (Saravali 34.1-7)

Raman (HJH vol. 1, pp. 249-250): Jupiter or Venus in the lagna with the 6th lord aspected by Saturn, Rahu or Mars brings trouble from relatives

Classical partial aspects: one-half from houses 9 and 5, three-quarters from houses 10 and 6. Jataka Parijata 2.31 calls Saturn exceedingly powerful through its 3rd/10th ('quarter') aspect; JP 2.32 says Saturn's look inclines downward. As a natural malefic its aspect is classed as harmful (Phaladeepika 15.2; Braha: harm plus an ascetic, restrictive quality), but when Saturn owns the house, or is yogakaraka, sources read it as protective or strengthening (Phaladeepika 15.1; Saravali 34.8; Raman).
